text: {"lessons":["Repeatedly selling Stock E at a gain felt rewarding, but I should trim only when its outlook or portfolio weight justifies it—not simply to lock in profit.","The account moved both up and down while I held steady, reminding me that short-term swings alone are not a reason to trade; I should stick to a considered plan.","Before buying more of Stocks A, B, or C, I should assess their combined concentration and the cash I need, rather than treating each decision in isolation."]}
